---
title: "Heatmap"
author: "Filipos"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}

# Load the augmented data
load(here("data", "03_cancer_augment.RData"))

# Reshape to long format and calculate mutation percentage per cancer type
heatmap_data <- clinical_augment |>
  # Gather all 20 num_mut_* columns into two columns: 'gene' and 'mut_count'
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("num_mut_"),
    names_to = "gene",
    values_to = "mut_count"
  ) |>
  # Clean up the gene names by removing the "num_mut_" prefix
  mutate(gene = str_remove(gene, "^num_mut_")) |>
  # Group by cancer type and gene
  group_by(cancer_type, gene) |>
  # Calculate the % of samples in that cancer type that have at least 1 mutation
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_mutated = sum(mut_count > 0),
    pct_mutated = (n_mutated / n_samples) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
heatmap_data |>
  # Order genes so the most frequently mutated ones appear at the top
  mutate(gene = fct_reorder(gene, pct_mutated, .fun = mean)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cancer_type, y = gene, fill = pct_mutated)) +
  # Draw the heatmap tiles with thin white borders
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Add exact percentage numbers inside the tiles
  geom_text(aes(label = round(pct_mutated, 0)), size = 2.8, color = "black") +
  # Use a clean color gradient from light to dark
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#f7fbff",
    high = "#08519c",
    name = "Mutated\nSamples (%)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mutation Frequency of Top 20 Driver Genes Across Cancer Types",
    subtitle = "Values inside tiles indicate percentage (%) of samples with ≥1 mutation",
    x = "Cancer Type",
    y = "Driver Gene"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```
